scope: Checked lazy branching on a supplied qualifying variable set for a guarded constructor. Exact branch coverage preserves original private IDs; decisions are correct when qualification passes; at most2^k leaf calls for k distinct supplied keys. Rejected sets return none.
deployment: structured supplied-input method; no automatic decomposition or small-set guarantee
limits: Qualification is sufficient, not necessary: a checked example has recognizable individual branches while common deletion qualification rejects.
Unsupported cases include both SAT and UNSAT formulas; rejection is not a refutation.
No efficient variable-set discovery or bound making k logarithmic for arbitrary SAT.
No full bit-runtime bound; each leaf currently repeats orientation recognition.
